1. Before you start

This guide covers the Workforce Management (WFM) module as it is configured for BIM Infotech. It is written for administrators and supervisors — the people who set the rules, manage employees and sign off attendance each month. Every screenshot is from your own workspace.

Signing in

  1. Go to bim.bpmsquare.com.
  2. Sign in with your User ID and password, or with Sign in with face if you have enrolled.
  3. Employees do not need a personal email address — your workspace is set to User ID login.

Who can see what

RoleSees
EmployeeMy Workforce only — their own punches, timesheet, requests and calendar.
SupervisorEverything below: Live board, Employees, Corrections, Roster, Leave & Holidays and Time Summary, for the people they supervise.
AdministratorAll of the above, plus Settings → Workforce, where the rules themselves are set.
Note Workforce menu items are hidden from a plain employee login. If a supervisor tells you a menu item is missing, check their WFM role on the Employees screen first.

Finding your way around

The dark strip down the left is the navigation rail. It starts collapsed to icons — click the ▶ at the top to expand it and see the labels. Items are grouped, and the two groups that matter for WFM are:

Sidebar groupWhat is in it
WORKFORCE → WorkforceMy Workforce, Live board, Employees, Corrections, Roster, Leave & Holidays, Time Summary.
ADMINData Workbench (bulk import/export), Audit & Users.

Workspace-wide configuration is not in those groups — it is behind the ⚙ gear icon at the bottom of the rail, under Settings → Workforce.

Note Every screen in this guide also opens from the ⌘K command palette (Ctrl+K on Windows) — press it and type the screen name. It is the fastest route once you know what you are looking for.

2. Workforce setup — Settings → Workforce

How to get thereLeft sidebar → ⚙ Settings (the gear at the bottom of the icon rail) → Workforce. Then use the tabs across the top: General · Sites · Shifts · Leave Types · Kiosks.
Direct link: bim.bpmsquare.com/settings/workforce

Everything that shapes how people punch in and take leave lives in one place: Settings → Workforce. It has five tabs — General, Sites, Shifts, Leave Types and Kiosks.

Important Changes here affect every employee immediately. On the General tab nothing is saved until you press Save at the bottom; the Sites, Shifts and Leave Types tabs save row by row.

General — the attendance rules

The General tab is a set of collapsible groups. Each one shows a one-line summary of its current state — click a group to open it and change anything inside. Your current settings are:

SettingYour valueWhat it does
TimezoneAsia/KolkataThe clock every day-boundary and lateness calculation runs in.
Employee self-serviceOnEmployees punch from their own phone. Turn this off if punching should be kiosk-only.
Employee loginUser IDNo personal email needed — the system mints an internal address per employee.
Working hoursCheck-out − check-in − breaksWorked hours are net of breaks. This is the same figure the employee's timesheet and the monthly export show, so the two can never disagree.
Late marks per half-day10Every 10 late marks in a calendar month counts as one half-day deduction on the summary. It is a count only — no money is calculated from it.
Leave carry-forwardUnused leave lapses at year endSwitch to carry-forward if unused balance should roll into next year.
Selfie retention60 daysPunch selfies are purged after 60 days. Enrolment photos are kept until the employee is deleted.
Face verificationFlag onlyA face that does not match the enrolled photo raises a flag — it never blocks the punch.
Geofence enforcementFlag onlyA punch outside every site radius still succeeds, but is marked. Set it to Block to reject such a punch outright.
Location required to punchYesCheck in and check out are rejected without a location fix. Breaks and overtime are deliberately left alone, because those often happen indoors.
Selfie required to punchShift punchesCheck in, check out and mobile-work starts require a selfie; breaks and overtime do not.
Weekly off daysSundayNo lateness or absence is marked on these days, or on configured holidays.
Employment typesFull-time, InternThe monthly Excel export gets one sheet per type.
Punch typesOvertime onWork from home and Site visit are off. Check in, check out and breaks are always available.
Phone remindersAll offLong-day, break and holiday-week push alerts — see the note below.
Alternate SaturdaysOffEvery Saturday follows the standing shift.
Email notifications5 of 6 onPer-event emails: late arrival, correction filed, leave filed, day flagged for recheck, overtime/WFH request, clarification message.
Important Never change an employment type's code once people are assigned to it. The code is what each employee record stores — changing it leaves those employees classified under the old value. Edit the label instead.
Note Phone reminders need two things before they deliver anything: push keys configured on the server, and the employee tapping Turn on for notifications on their own phone. Switching them on here alone will silently do nothing.

Sites

A site is a place people punch in at. Its radius is the geofence — how far from the pin a punch still counts as on-site. Its supervisor approves the overtime, leave and corrections of everyone assigned to work there, and you can name extra approvers alongside them so requests do not wait when one person is away.

SiteSupervisorGeofence
Gowribidnoor officeMatheen Ahmed A (EMP-0012)150 m
Manuvana OfficeMatheen Ahmed A (EMP-0012)150 m
RT Nagar officeShabbir Syed (EMP-0001)200 m
Vijayanagar OfficeMatheen Ahmed A (EMP-0012)150 m
Yelehanka officeNot assigned150 m
Important Yelehanka office currently has no supervisor, and the page warns about it at the top. Overtime, leave and correction requests from people working there have nobody to approve them — they will sit in the queue indefinitely. Assign a supervisor on that row.
Note Check each site's pin as well as its radius. A site whose coordinates are wrong will mark every punch there as outside the geofence; because your geofence setting is Flag only, those punches still succeed but arrive flagged for review.

Shifts

A shift is the working hours people are expected to keep. Grace is how late someone can check in before it counts as a late mark. Add one with the form at the top; existing shifts can be edited or deactivated.

ShiftTimingGraceStatus
First Shift07:00 – 15:3030 minActive
General Shift09:00 – 18:0030 minActive
Second Shift14:00 – 23:0030 minActive
OT21:00 – 06:00 next day10 minActive
Important A shift whose end time is earlier than its start time runs past midnight — tick Night shift so those hours are counted on the day the shift started, rather than split across two days. Your OT shift (21:00–06:00) is the one this applies to.
Note Your shift list also holds two inactive duplicate “General Shift” rows. They are harmless — inactive shifts cannot be assigned — but tidying them up makes the roster dropdown clearer.

Leave Types

Leave types are what people can request time off as. Each one is Paid or Unpaid, which is what splits the Paid leave and Unpaid leave columns on the monthly summary — so get these right before the first month closes.

FieldWhat it does
QuotaEach employee's default allowance, per month or per year.
Max a monthA monthly quota is also the most anyone can take that month — a request beyond it is refused. A yearly quota can carry a separate monthly cap.
Paid days a monthPays only the first N days of that type each month; the rest count as unpaid on the time summary.

Your active types are CompOff (paid, 1/month) and Sick (paid, 1/month). Paid Leave (20/year) and Unpaid Leave (12/year) are currently inactive.

Note A leave type that already has history can be deactivated but never deleted — that is deliberate, so past months keep reporting correctly. Deactivating simply stops anyone requesting it from now on.

Kiosks

A kiosk is a registered tablet at a door. It identifies an enrolled employee by face and offers the valid punch buttons — no login on the device. Face punch is on for your workspace; an employee must have a face enrolled before a kiosk will recognise them.

3. Employees

How to get thereLeft sidebar → WORKFORCE → Workforce → Employees.
Direct link: bim.bpmsquare.com/wfm/employees

Workforce → Employees is the master list. Everything else in WFM — roster, attendance, leave, the payroll summary — keys off a record here.

What the columns mean

ColumnMeaning
CodeThe employee number (EMP-0001…), generated automatically and used on every export.
TypeEmployment type — Full-time or Intern. Decides which sheet they land on in the monthly export.
WFM roleEmployee or Supervisor. Supervisor unlocks the whole Workforce menu for that person.
ShiftTheir standing shift, used whenever the roster has no specific assignment for a date.
Home siteDefault site for geofence checks and site-based reporting.
SupervisorWho approves this person's corrections, leave and overtime.
LoginWhether a sign-in has been created for them.
ConsentWhether they have accepted the biometric and data consent.
FaceWhether an enrolment photo exists — required for kiosk face punch and face sign-in.
StatusActive or inactive.

Common tasks

TaskHow
Add someone+ New employee, then fill in name, type, shift, home site and supervisor.
Change detailsSelect the row, then Edit.
Give someone a loginEdit the employee and set a User ID and password.
Reset a forgotten passwordSelect the row, then Reset password. Employees cannot reset their own — the sign-in page tells them to ask a supervisor.
Enrol a faceSelect the row, then Enroll, and capture the photo. Needed for kiosk face punch and face sign-in.
Someone leavesDeactivate — this keeps their history for past months. Use Remove only for a record created in error.
Important Deactivating an employee stops them appearing in day-to-day lists, but does not by itself revoke an existing login. When someone leaves, remove their login as a separate step.

An employee record

Opening an employee gives you everything about that person in one place — useful when you are investigating a disputed day before approving a correction. The header shows their code, employment type, site, shift, hours this month and anything pending; six tabs sit underneath.

TabShows
OverviewLeave balance per type, and what is coming up in the next 14 days.
AttendanceEvery punch, day by day.
CorrectionsTheir correction requests and the outcome of each.
LeaveTheir leave requests, with a count of anything pending.
RosterTheir site and shift assignments.
FlaggedDays the system marked for review.

4. Roster — who works where, on which shift

How to get thereLeft sidebar → WORKFORCE → Workforce → Roster.
Direct link: bim.bpmsquare.com/wfm/roster

Workforce → Roster assigns a site and a shift per employee, per date range. Where the roster says nothing, the employee's standing shift and home site apply, so you only need to roster the exceptions.

Assigning in bulk

  1. Narrow the list with the site dropdown at the top.
  2. Tick the employees you want, or use Select all.
  3. Use Apply to … selected to set a site and shift for the chosen date range in one action.
  4. Press Save changes. Nothing is written until you do.
Note Each site and shift column also has its own Assign all shortcut, and Clear all removes assignments in that column.

Alternate Saturdays

If you switch Alternate Saturdays on in Settings, the Generate button here writes that month's short-Saturday roster rows and the 2nd-Saturday holiday. It only adds — it never overwrites an assignment a supervisor has already made.

5. Live board — today at a glance

How to get thereLeft sidebar → WORKFORCE → Workforce → Live board.
Direct link: bim.bpmsquare.com/wfm/live-board

Workforce → Live board shows today's attendance as it happens: who is in, who is late, who has not arrived, and any flags raised on a punch.

ColumnMeaning
StatusPresent, late, absent or on leave for today.
First in / Last outThe earliest check-in and the latest check-out recorded so far.
FlagsAnything the system marked: outside geofence, face mismatch, missing selfie, incomplete day.
Note Use the site filter to narrow to one office. The On login, show me setting fixes which site you land on by default.

6. Corrections, flagged days and overtime

How to get thereLeft sidebar → WORKFORCE → Workforce → Corrections. The three queues are the buttons at the top of that page.
Direct link: bim.bpmsquare.com/wfm/corrections

Workforce → Corrections is the approval desk. It holds three queues, each with a Pending / All filter.

QueueWhat lands here
CorrectionsAn employee asking to fix a punch — a missed check-in or check-out, or a wrong time.
Flagged for reviewDays the system marked itself: outside geofence, face mismatch, incomplete day.
OvertimeOvertime sessions awaiting approval. Only approved overtime reaches the monthly summary and gets priced.

Approving

  1. Open the queue and leave the filter on Pending.
  2. Check the Reason and Proposed time against the employee's other punches that day.
  3. Approve writes the corrected time into attendance, and it flows straight through to the timesheet and the monthly summary. Reject leaves the record as it was.
Important Approved overtime is what gets paid. It is priced at the overtime rate per hour set in Settings → Workforce. If that rate is 0, overtime hours are still tracked but no amount is calculated.

7. Leave & Holidays

How to get thereLeft sidebar → WORKFORCE → Workforce → Leave & Holidays. Switch between the Leave and Holidays tabs at the top.
Direct link: bim.bpmsquare.com/wfm/leave

Workforce → Leave & Holidays has two tabs: Leave for requests, and Holidays for the company calendar.

Leave requests

  1. Leave the filter on Pending to see only what needs a decision.
  2. Review the employee, leave type, dates, half-day flag and reason.
  3. Approve or Reject. Approved leave shows as leave — not absence — on the monthly summary.
Note Add leave lets you record leave on someone's behalf, for a phone call or a paper form. The leave types themselves, and whether each is paid, are configured under Settings → Workforce → Leave Types.

Holidays

Add holiday takes a date, a name, and who it applies to — everyone, or a single site. No lateness or absence is marked on a holiday, and the holiday-week reminder reads this same list, so the calendar and the timesheet can never disagree.

Important Set the holiday calendar for the year before the month starts. Adding a holiday after the fact does not retrospectively rewrite days you have already closed off and exported.

8. Time Summary — closing the month

How to get thereLeft sidebar → WORKFORCE → Workforce → Time Summary. Pick Daily — detailed, Monthly summary or Custom range at the top.
Direct link: bim.bpmsquare.com/wfm/summary

Workforce → Time Summary is where the month is closed and handed to the CA. It has three modes: Daily — detailed, Monthly summary and Custom range.

Reading the month

The three cards at the top summarise the month before you look at anyone individually: how days split across present, late, absent, leave, week off and incomplete; how many employees need attention and why; and headcount by site.

ColumnMeaning
Days present / AbsentCounted against the roster and the holiday calendar.
HoursWorked time, net of breaks.
Late marksCheck-ins later than shift start plus that shift's grace period.
Half-day ded.Late marks divided by 10, per your setting.
Paid / Unpaid leaveFrom approved leave requests, split by whether the leave type is paid.
HolidaysDays from the holiday calendar that fall in the period.
Night shifts / Night allowanceShifts qualifying for the night allowance, and the amount.
OT hrs / OT amtApproved overtime only, priced at the configured rate.
IncompleteDays with a missing punch. Chase these before exporting.

Exporting for payroll

  1. Pick the month.
  2. Clear the Incomplete column first — every incomplete day is an unresolved correction.
  3. Press Export to Excel. The workbook has one sheet per employment type.
Important Export only once the Corrections and Overtime queues are empty for that month. Anything approved after you export will not be in the file you have already sent.

9. What your employees see

How to get thereThis is what the employee sees after signing in: Workforce → My Workforce. Supervisors and admins have the same screen for their own attendance.
Direct link: bim.bpmsquare.com/wfm/me

Employees get a single screen — My Workforce — on their phone. Knowing what it looks like makes their questions much faster to answer.

TabWhat they do there
AttendanceCheck in, check out, start and end a break, and start overtime.
TimeTheir own timesheet — worked hours, net of breaks.
RequestsFile a correction, request leave or overtime, and track the status.
CalendarTheir roster, holidays and approved leave.
ProfileConsent, face enrolment and password.

The three things they will ask you

They sayThe cause
“It won't let me check in.”Location is required for check in and check out in your workspace. If they denied the location permission the punch is rejected. They must tap Allow location.
“It's asking for a photo.”A selfie is required for shift punches. Denying the camera ends the punch — it does not fall through without one.
“I forgot to punch out.”They file a correction from Requests, and it appears in your Corrections queue.
Note Install app adds BPMSquare to the phone's home screen. It is the same web app, not a download from an app store.

10. Bulk employee data — Data Workbench

How to get thereLeft sidebar → ADMIN → Data Workbench. Choose Import / Export / Update at the top, then the Employees object.
Direct link: bim.bpmsquare.com/data-workbench

Data Workbench moves employee records in and out in bulk, using Excel or CSV. Choose the Employees object, then one of three modes.

ModeUse it to
ImportCreate new employees from a file — onboarding a whole site at once.
ExportPull every employee out, including the real record ID.
UpdateChange existing employees in bulk.

The rule that saves you

Important A file for Update must come from an Export. Update matches rows on the Record ID column, and only an Export fills that in. Never hand-type it or build an update file from names or codes — two people can share a name, and a mistyped ID can land the change on the wrong record.
  1. Pick Employees, then Export, and download the file.
  2. Edit only the columns you intend to change. Leave Record ID untouched.
  3. Switch to Update, upload the edited file, match the columns, and read the preview before confirming.
Note Templates always match your current field setup, including any custom fields you have added, so download a fresh template rather than reusing an old one.
Note Data Workbench also lists objects belonging to other BPMSquare modules that your workspace does not use. For BIM, Employees is the relevant one.
